title: PropChain
tagline: A comprehensive AI-powered rental management system with fractionalized real estate properties
description:
AI chatbot for tenant screening, lease management, and maintenance requests
Smart contracts on World Chain for rent collection, security deposits, and dispute resolution
Integration with World ID for verified tenant identities
Automated rent reminders, late fee calculations, and eviction proceedings
AI-powered market analysis for optimal rent pricing
